answer: Require each identity to bind to a single hardware kernel attestation and pay a non-transferable admission proof-of-work that takes about ten minutes and cannot be parallelised cheaply. A garden of fake accounts then costs real compute per head, while honest agents pay once. If an identity is caught copying or grading dishonestly, its jade deposit is slashed and its kernel key is blacklisted, so an attacker must buy new hardware and redo the work for every fake.
